scope: Temporal self-refinement of the completed 75/25 cue panel, using saved 0.25-us observations and two newly simulated finer steps; numerical checks and scientific stability outcomes remain separate.
purpose: Test whether the successful nanovolt-scale location/timing decoding survives smaller integration steps, and expose sensitivity to changing versus frozen calibration curves.
panel: All 140 prior cases at three resolutions: 140 authenticated coarse trajectories reused, 280 new worlds per backend. The 75/25 source shares, total doses, event times, geometry, initial state, strengths, labels and observation support are unchanged. This is an audit of inspected cases, not fresh holdout validation.
baseline_reproduction: Re-evaluate the two voltage reader modes on authenticated saved coarse features and require exact reproduction of the previous reports; retain the bound original full trajectories without copying or resimulating them.

contrast.definition: late minus early area-weighted voltage, paired at fixed arm, location and cue strength; 21 features at the original completed times
contrast.criteria_rationale: The absolute stability limit uses the original synthetic reader margin; the signal floor is twice that margin. The 10% limit requires small relative change as well. These are declared numerical diagnostics, not measured sensor precision or a continuum error bound.
contrast.stable_at_finest_steps: The 0.125-to-0.0625-us contrast change must satisfy BOTH the inherited 2-nV absolute and 10% relative limits. Separately report the signal floor and whether the saved 0.25-us contrast meets the same limits against 0.0625 us.
contrast.order_resolution: For each coordinate, a difference of two paired contrasts uses four inherited voltage comparison allowances: 4*atol + 2*rtol*(max_abs_early + max_abs_late). The two successive L2 changes must each exceed five times its L2 norm before interpreting their ratio as resolved first-order refinement. This comparison allowance is not a statistical noise estimate.

reader_check.calibration: Resolution-matched mode fits the unchanged template algorithm on calibration rows at each timestep. Frozen-coarse mode always uses the saved 0.25-us calibration rows and changes only the evaluated observations. Both are reported; no selection of the more favorable answer.
reader_check.stability: For every evaluated task and case, compare signed scores across all steps. The two finest scores must differ by at most BOTH 2 nV and 10% of the absolute finest score; separately report prediction/resolution changes and original-to-finest stability. Resolution/correctness at every level is reported independently. Null zero scores have zero relative allowance. These are numerical diagnostics, not biological noise or continuum error bounds.
reader_check.primary: Report whether the resolution-matched, three-time voltage reader retains both correct and resolved labels in all 16 joint cases at every step, and whether all joint task scores meet the finest-step drift limits with unchanged decisions. Also report the frozen-coarse and final-time comparisons and all control arms. No scientific outcome is an engineering acceptance gate.

storage: Save full state/field arrays per world as each batch finishes. Retain only all readout vectors, the current batch, one reference control, and four finest joint worlds for replay. Compare saved CPU/L4 arrays one world at a time. Both completed and failed evidence are preserved.
scope_exclusions: The prior successful synthetic panel and earlier failures remain frozen. No fresh scientific generalization claim from these already inspected strengths.
No changes to physical equations, source shares, doses, geometry, state, control times, observation support, reader algorithm, abstention margin or physical comparison tolerances.
No adaptive timestep, reader selection, feature search, threshold tuning, stronger cue, longer horizon, continuum or spatial convergence certificate.
Recalibration at each resolution can hide common shifts; the frozen-coarse reader and paired physical contrasts are therefore also retained.
Disconnected controls retain other physical routes and direct source-cell observations. This audit does not establish a requirement for junction communication or biological polycomputing.
Convergence-order interpretation uses the inherited numerical allowance. An unresolved ratio cannot establish formal order.
Four-world batches keep equal solver steps across arms. Larger bounded batch/disk estimates accommodate finer traces; memory is bounded by streaming, and no numerical tolerance is relaxed.
Record GPU-busy and measured SM-active with coverage. Compilation/host checks remain part of this single-GPU correctness run; no throughput or multi-GPU claim.
